title: Practise on the guitar
strokeHint: Practise the chosen stroke on your guitar. Playback uses the same guitar sample for tirando and apoyando.
technicalHint: Grade 5 technical work, without an exam board. Scales and arpeggios span two octaves; interval scales and broken chords span one.

items.brokenChord-upper: Broken chord, tonic one octave higher

reason.noRoute: No suggested route fits this range and the available hand shifts.
reason.heptatonic: Routes are available for seven-note scales with one letter per degree. Choose a scale above.
reason.majorMinor: This exercise needs a major or minor key. Change the scale in Explore.
reason.noPair: No playable sequence of pairs fits this neck with the required string spacing.
reason.standardOnly: Right-hand chord patterns use standard tuning. Change the tuning on the fretboard.
reason.noGrip: No chord grip supports this pattern in this key.
reason.beyond-neck: The top notes cannot fit across three strings within frets 0–15.
reason.bass-notes-on-one-string: The low notes share one string and cannot ring together. Try the tonic one octave higher.
reason.closed-style: This exercise uses open strings; a closed-position route is not offered.
reason.no-holdable-grip: No sequence of grips can hold all three notes of each group.
reason.noWalk: No suggested walk connects two complete scales with guide-finger shifts in this tuning while keeping one hand shape in each position. Try another scale in Explore.

rightHandLegend: p = thumb · i = index · m = middle · a = ring
chromaticSpelling: Chromatic convention: sharps going up, flats coming down; the starting note keeps its spelling.
beatHint: Tempo in beats per minute, one note or simultaneous group per beat.
audioError: Audio could not start. Try Play again.
staff: Current notes, guitar treble clef with octave below
overrideHint: Teacher fingerings are saved for this route. Shift marks describe the suggested route; changing a finger does not recompute them.
suggested: Suggested fingering. 0 = open string; ↗ = shift up, ↘ = shift down.
noRing: Release each note before the next.
walkHint: Play the scale in each position, then follow the connecting notes to the next. Slide the named guide finger along the same string. Each ascent spans one or two octaves; connecting notes keep the selected scale form, including melodic minor.
